sum: Mako Mining Corp. engages in mineral exploration and exploitation activities in Nicaragua, the United States, and Guyana. The company explores for gold and silver deposits. Its primary asset is its 100%-owned San Albino mine comprising the San Albino and the Las Conchitas gold deposits, which consist of five mineral concessions covering an area of approximately 22,422 hectares located within the San Albino-Murra Property in Nueva Segovia, Nicaragua. The company was formerly known as Golden Reign Resources Ltd. and changed its name to Mako Mining Corp. in November 2018. Mako Mining Corp. was incorporated in 2004 and is headquartered in Vancouver, Canada.
